hook.es: Para cualquiera es una computadora. Para ellos es una nave.
hook.en: To anyone else, it's a computer. To them, it's a ship.

objective: A borrowed gaming PC arrives and is converted into a worker in the Parallel World. NØVA realizes any machine can be connected if you know how.

metadata.call_to_action: ¿Podemos convertir cualquier máquina en parte del mundo?

captions.es: Un PC prestado se convierte en nave.
captions.en: A borrowed PC becomes a ship.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: A gaming PC tower glowing with the Parallel World's geometry, transforming into a small ship-like worker form

notes: Theme: resourcefulness — building with what's borrowed/available, not waiting for ideal tools.
Emotional conflict: precariousness of depending on something temporary/borrowed.
Dialogue beat: NØVA — "¿Entonces podemos convertir cualquier máquina en parte del mundo?" The Traveler — "Si sabemos conectarla."
Directly inspired by real infra work (feat/pc-gamer-worker-plane) — keep grounded, don't overstate capability.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 08.
